description: This file defines a Retrofit interface for interacting with backend cart operations in an online shopping platform. It includes methods for fetching the current cart, adding items, updating quantities, removing items, and clearing the cart. The interface abstracts REST API endpoints related to cart management, scoped to a specific user identified via email.

classes.name: CartApi
classes.description: Retrofit interface for backend cart operations, including methods to get, add, update, remove, and clear cart items.

methods.name: getCurrentCart
methods.description: Fetches the current cart for the user, identified by email, via a GET request.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the cart; can merge quantities or override existing items.

methods.name: updateQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific item in the cart.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart using the product ID.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Clears the entire cart for the user.
